title: Sharp Free Energy of the Two-Dimensional Heisenberg Ferromagnet
exact_target: Prove the lower free-energy estimate needed to make the two-dimensional ferromagnet\textquotesingle s spin-wave prediction sharp.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004243 (OWR-17137-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/41, pp. 2541--2603. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 42.

status_qualification: The Hamiltonian normalization determines the coefficient $\pi/24$. It must not be changed by an unreported coupling rescaling. The meaning of matching, including the range of $\kappa$, remains the comparison asked in the report.
